Chapter 847: Chapter 36 Stepping Into The Eleventh Order (End Of This Volume, Asking For Subscriptions)

Chapter 847: Chapter 36 Stepping into the Eleventh Order (End of this volume, asking for subscriptions)

The river of time flows majestically.

From the ancient past towards the distant future.

It seems eternally unchanging.

Even the most extraordinary life forms, as long as they haven’t made the ultimate leap,

Can only stir up a corner of the river’s waves, ultimately perishing as the river runs dry.

On the shore.

One towering figure after another appears, carefully observing every detail around the river of time.

During the ultimate phase of Level Eleven beings’ assault, external forces cannot stop them.

But once the assault is complete, successfully stepping into Level Twelve.

They must ‘come ashore’.

This is also the opportunity for the Insect Race and Tianyu Clan’s strongest beings.

An ultimate being that has just entered Level Twelve is undoubtedly at its most vulnerable.

Even with the protection of nine supreme beings from human civilization, a sudden surprise attack by them can have a significant impact.

The supreme beings of the Insect Race and Tianyu Clan do not harbor illusions of killing that supreme being from human civilization, but at least they can inflict some damage.

In this way, the pressure on them later on would be much lighter.

…

Taking advantage of the moment a Level Twelve being ‘comes ashore’ to launch a surprise attack is a grudge that warrants relentless pursuit.

Therefore…

Under normal circumstances, no supreme being standing on the shore would easily do this.

Mainly because even a being that has just stepped into Level Twelve isn’t so easy to kill, as the essence of life has undergone the ultimate leap, it’s very difficult to completely perish.

And if the attack fails, it would create an irreconcilable formidable enemy for themselves and their affiliated forces.

The potential risks involved are great, even related to the end of the Cosmic Era, when many Level Twelve beings ‘struggle to cross over’ to withstand the Great Destructive Force.

However, such influences are of no significance to the Insect Race and Tianyu Clan.

The civilization of humankind and theirs are already in a life-or-death feud.

Even if they do not act, the hatred between them will not disappear.

If a Level Eleven Perfect being from the Insect Race or Tianyu Clan manages to step into Level Twelve and ‘come ashore’, it’s estimated that the nine supreme beings from human civilization would not hesitate to seize the opportunity to strike.

The conflict between clans has never been about the strong bullying the weak.

The main reason why supreme beings of the Starry Sky Races rarely enter the fray is that if everyone participates, it’s equivalent to no one participating.

And if the intensity of the war is too high, it can also affect the development of various peak clan forces.

That’s why the current balance is maintained.

If there were an opportunity to completely eradicate the forces of other clans, it’s estimated there would be no hesitation.

“Let’s wait.”

“We’ll just watch from the shore.”

“When that Level Eleven evolutionary from humanity begins to ‘come ashore’, you must not hold back.”

The supreme beings from the Insect Race, Tianyu Clan, and many others exchange glances, also vigilant for traces of the nine supreme beings of human civilization.

They can think of ‘sniping’ at the riverbank of time; surely, the supreme beings of human civilization have taken precautions.

Now, the contest is about the foundation of their respective strengths.

…

Milky Way Star Region.

Deep within the Spatial Layers.

Lin Yuan tries to draw in the endless Chaos Void Origin into his body as much as possible.

His physical Soul Body and inner world are like having taken a tonic, starting to rapidly increase in strength.

Especially his inner world, as it feels ‘full’ upon receiving Chaos Void Origin Infusion for the twentieth second.

With the sense of ‘fullness’ comes the feeling of breaking through limitations.

That’s why Lin Yuan doesn’t stop absorbing the Chaos Void Origin.

The thirtieth second.

The feeling of ‘fullness’ intensifies.

The fortieth second.

The ‘fullness’ reaches a certain limit.

The fiftieth second.

The ‘fullness’ vanishes with a bang.

At the same time.

His inner world, originally spanning 2.33 billion square miles, seems to have torn through a thin layer of paper, with its area going crazy expanding again.

23 billion miles.

33 billion miles.

43 billion miles.

110 billion miles.

…

At the three-hundredth second of Chaos Void Origin Infusion.

Lin Yuan’s inner world has already reached six trillion square miles in the area.

The vast power of the world nourishes his physical Soul Body, and with the continuous absorption of Chaos Void Origin, Lin Yuan’s strength has increased countless times compared to before his breakthrough.

Soon.

The three hundred and thirty-third second ends.

The crack in the sky, spanning hundreds of light-years, quickly begins to heal.

The aura of Chaos Void Origin also rapidly dissipates.

“Under normal circumstances, a Level Eleven Perfect being assaulting the ultimate would now make the ultimate leap, using the arrival of Chaos Void Origin and the momentary stepping back of the cosmic rules to cross that critical step.”

Lin Yuan ponders in his heart.

With the arrival of Chaos Void Origin, numerous cosmic rule restrictions naturally disappear temporarily, making it the best time for a Level Eleven Perfect being to assault the ultimate.

Losing this opportunity, it’s almost impossible to make another assault on the ultimate.

Any life form assaulting the ultimate means completely breaking free from universal restrictions, and in such a case, the universe will naturally try its best to prevent it.

Becoming a supreme being, breaking free from the shackles of the river of time, means potentially taking away everything absorbed from the universe.

“But I don’t really need to do that.”

Lin Yuan shakes his head slightly. He still has another chance to trigger the Chaos Void Origin Infusion.

Although with Lin Yuan’s foundation, he can entirely surpass Level Eleven to assault the ultimate, the risk is still too great.

Lin Yuan still has a lot of room for improvement, not to mention comprehending the legendary Chaos Rule. The deeper the foundation accumulated during the Level Eleven phase, the greater the advantage in assaulting Level Twelve.

“My inner world has now reached eight trillion square miles…”
